result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly. Header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, list cards and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. One likely visual defect was found in the first 'Fastest near you' card, plus a minor inconsistency in the heart buttons.

issues.description: In the Green Bowl Poké card, the food image appears shifted down within its thumbnail. The plate's lower portion sits under the '15–25 min' badge, and the plate rim seems to render over or into the right edge of the badge. The Smash Bros Burgers card shows its image cleanly above the badge. This suggests an image-positioning or layering error on this card.
issues.suggestion: Center or crop the thumbnail consistently with the other cards (e.g., object-fit: cover with centered positioning). Make sure the time badge has a higher z-index than the image so no artwork draws over it.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a circular backdrop that nearly blends into the dark image. The same button on the next card has a clearly visible translucent circle, so the styling is inconsistent and the ramen card's button is harder to see.
issues.suggestion: Give the heart button a consistent semi-transparent backdrop with enough contrast on all images, e.g., a darker scrim or a subtle border or shadow.
